# Frames with Fully Kiosk wake up on time again
### Fixed
- **A frame with Fully Kiosk did not wake up in the morning:** night rest switched the screen off completely, which makes Fully freeze the page - so it could not switch itself on again when the night ended (and tapping did not help either). Now the page sets the **brightness to 0** and shows black at night, but keeps running, and restores the brightness by itself when the night ends. If you want the screen really off, use your own automation (see the README).

Update: `cd ~/immich-showcase && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d`. ☕ [ko-fi.com/frameside](https://ko-fi.com/frameside)
